title: Step 58-B frontend workspace and build foundation
description: Create only the production storefront workspace/build foundation: exact-pinned React Router Framework Mode on Vite with TypeScript and SSR, deterministic pnpm workspace/lockfile, real type-check/static-quality/build scripts, environment secrecy boundary, and root canonical verification integration. Do not implement Stage C shell/RTL/i18n, customer features, API/auth/business authority, Admin frontend, backend mutations or Step 59.

dependencies.name: Stage 58-A canonical handoff and frontend scope freeze

canonical_ci_initial_failure.cause: project policy scanner recursively traversed apps/storefront/node_modules and treated vendor declarations as source
canonical_ci_initial_failure.remediation: exclude node_modules directory names from filesUnder recursion without excluding any src/apps source path

acceptance_criteria.description: Storefront workspace uses exact-pinned React Router Framework Mode on Vite, React, TypeScript and SSR compatible with canonical Node 24.18.1 and pnpm 11.21.0, with free/open-source dependencies only.
Clean frozen install plus storefront typecheck, configured ESLint static-quality and SSR build pass; lockfile is pnpm-generated rather than manually invented.

Canonical root pnpm verify executes frontend verification while preserving the existing backend verification chain, and the project-policy scanner excludes vendored node_modules while continuing to scan source under src/apps.

Stage B has no customer/commercial route or page, no Stage C RTL/i18n shell, no API client/auth/session/business authority, no Admin frontend, no backend/API/database/migration mutation and no Step 59 implementation.
Server/public environment boundary is documented; VITE_* is browser-visible and no secret, credential, token or authoritative business configuration is committed.

Canonical completion requires exact-head verify, phase-a and merge-policy PASS, artifact-bound REVIEW and ACTIVE LOCK for MEDIUM risk, protected merge, and exact-SHA post-merge verification before Stage C can start.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage B is MEDIUM risk. No direct-main write or raw merge is canonical. Stage C and Step 59 remain forbidden until Stage B protected transport and exact-SHA post-merge verification are green.
